Fiber Internet Troubleshooting Guide

If your optical network terminal (ONT) LOS indicator light is red, please follow these steps:

  1. Check the fiber optic cable connection to the port.
  2. Power cycle the router by unplugging for 30 seconds.
  3. Contact support at 111 if the LOS light remains flashing red.
